notes: Renamed the cards that all shared the name Second Chance / Second Chances, which also collided with the Second Chance mulligan step at the start of every match. Each card now has its own distinct name and is easier to tell apart.
fixes: Hope's amulet, formerly Second Chances, is now The Comeback Trail.
Hope's Legendary recovery follower, formerly Second Chance, is now Renewed Faith.
Hope's Epic spell that turns enemies into Newcomers, formerly Second Chance, is now Clean Slate.
The Universal Legendary recovery follower, formerly Second Chance, is now Renewed Resolve.
These names no longer collide with each other or with the Second Chance mulligan step at the start of every match.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
